The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] utilized a '''bunker''' in the [[Brell Sediment]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] to conduct research during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Thorus]] commanded the bunker, and surrendered to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Havoc Squad]] when the unit attacked the base.
